# FTI Consulting Advises on Yellow Hive Expansion into Germany with Acquisition of FVB


London, 30 October 2024 — FTI Consulting, Inc. (NYSE: FCN) and FTI Capital Advisors, the firm’s wholly owned global M&A advisory subsidiary, served as the exclusive financial advisor to Yellow Hive, a leading Dutch insurance distribution platform backed by IK Partners, on its acquisition of insurance broker FVB from HDI Deutschland AG.


FVB is a renowned insurance broker with nationwide coverage in Germany and specialises in brokering personal and commercial lines insurances and financial investment products. With this acquisition, Yellow Hive now has full national coverage across Germany and the Netherlands. The acquisition marks an important milestone in Yellow Hive’s growth strategy, which aims to drive expansion organically and through bolt-on acquisitions.


The deal also strengthens FTI Consulting’s position as a leading insurance M&A advisor in Europe, following a series of recent transactions, including the investment into Yellow Hive by[TPG](https://www.fticonsulting.com/uk/newsroom/press-releases/fti-consulting-advises-tpg-on-its-investment-into-yellow-hive) , the acquisition of Certe Group by[IceLake Capital](https://www.fticonsulting.com/uk/newsroom/press-releases/fti-consulting-advises-icelake-capital-investment-certe-group) and the investment into Paratus Holdings by[Ara Partners](https://www.fticonsulting.com/uk/newsroom/press-releases/fti-consulting-advises-ara-partners-investment-paratus) .


**About FTI Consulting**
FTI Consulting, Inc. is a global business advisory firm dedicated to helping organisations manage change, mitigate risk and resolve disputes: financial, legal, operational, political & regulatory, reputational and transactional. With more than 8,000 employees located in 33 countries and territories, FTI Consulting professionals work closely with clients to anticipate, illuminate and overcome complex business challenges and make the most of opportunities. In certain jurisdictions, FTI Consulting’s services are provided through distinct legal entities that are separately capitalized and independently managed. The Company generated $3.49 billion in revenues during fiscal year 2023. More information can be found at[www.fticonsulting.com](https://www.fticonsulting.com/) .


**About FTI Capital Advisors**
[FTI Capital Advisors](https://capitaladvisors.fticonsulting.com/) (“FTICA”) is a global M&A advisory firm with 11 offices worldwide, focused on M&A, equity and debt raising and independent financial advisory, across targeted industry sectors, including telecom media and technology, as well as aviation & aerospace, energy, financial services, healthcare, industrial and insurance. Backed by the power of FTI Consulting’s worldwide network of professionals, FTICA combines deep industry expertise with investment banking and transaction execution experience to deliver value-enhancing outcomes for our clients.
